sn1.74:2.4: The commentary says this refers to a child how testifies on one’s behalf in a court of law. But see Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 7.4.2.38: “children utter speech” (_prajā vācam pravadanti_) when one year old. I think this is about the joy a parent feels when they hear their child speak for the first time.
